titleRu: Ученые отслеживают 1750 бабочек-монархов; 175 обнаружено в Мексике
summary: In an innovative effort, researchers have equipped around 1,750 monarch butterflies with solar-powered trackers to study their extensive migration patterns. This advanced tracking technology offers insights into their traveling habits, including routes, daily distances, and resting points. Every year, these butterflies journey from Canada and the US to Mexico, and recent discoveries highlight the links between migration patterns and North American populations.
